crossRefs.note: And not a hair of your head will perish.
“By your endurance you will win your lives.
Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
“Don’t say, ‘A conspiracy!’ concerning all about which this people say, ‘A conspiracy!’ neither fear their threats, nor…
“I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who…
Have you forgotten Yahweh your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth? Do you live…
My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart! My heart trembles within me. I can’t hold my peace, because you…
Destruction on destruction is decreed, for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, and my…
You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not…
“When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.
For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There…
He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is…
But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

parallels.note: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

translations.web: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”
translations.bsb: When you hear of wars and rebellions, do not be alarmed. These things must happen first, but the end is not imminent.”
translations.kjv: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
translations.asv: And when ye shall hear of wars and tumults, be not terrified: for these things must needs come to pass first; but the end is not immediately.
